# APA-P10.A01.S02 — profile fields and edge materials (V2 publication pointer)

Full **9,492-character technical report** (source matrix, exact SDK29/Tapir versions and source lines, A/B architecture, 7 static + 4 synthetic checks, read-only acceptance, independent auditor questions) is already committed and read back at:

https://github.com/dvikt33-ux/safe-bim-layer/blob/research/apa-verified-results-hub-20261010/docs/research/apa-results/runs/2026-10-10/apa-technical-20261010-153928-profile-fields-edge-material-8c21.md

Tapir 1.5.9 and 1.7.0 `GetProfiles` allow `skinOutlines` in fields but its output is nested under `skins` and the derived-field gate does not include skinOutlines. Use `fields:["skins","skinOutlines"]` or omit fields. Profile edges may carry independent buildingMaterialId. Graphisoft SDK 29.3100 `profile_vectorImageItems` contains more than hatch outlines. SOURCE_VERIFIED only; installed custom 1.5.10, BUILD, LIVE NOT_VERIFIED. Existing composites/stories issues are cross-referenced, not reclassified as new.
